Memory planning, schema and snapshot validation

same_pid_jit_object_verification.scope: Actual executable bytes from the same owned process sampled for CPU self time, captured only after sampling; original Object provenance exact. No timing scores or hardware retirement counts.

interpretation.scope: Optimization15 diagnosis only; current accepted50, no holdout diagnosis or performance selection. No official timing observations.
interpretation.sample_scope: Warm checked calls plus output reset/drop between calls; fractions describe the diagnostic residence loop rather than exactly the frozen kernel timer. CPU samples are statistical attribution, not retired instructions, IPC, cache misses or copied-byte measurements.

observed.gramschmidt: 82.91995% generated self time; identified samples concentrate in ordered reduction traversal/cell checks and selected map evaluation/publication.
observed.durbin: 50.82825% generated self time; generated reduction, update and selected-publication loops remain alongside resource/planning/ownership costs. Skipping the unchanged suffix does not remove the active arithmetic.
observed.mvt: 33.86173% generated self time,17.65742% allocation/deallocation and11.05240% planning/schema/validation in the diagnostic loop. A distinct sampled transpose loop contains separate udiv and remainder-lowering udiv for each copied cell.

interpretation.byte_binding: Full numeric_5(19464B) and numeric_4(7608B) buffers are byte-identical, as is the complete MVT generated function(5112B). Every recorded hot instruction and surrounding68-byte window is identical across all three same-PID captures. Remaining root-function differences are one PC-relative external call relocation targeting the corresponding numeric function (3 differing bytes G,4 D), outside all verified sampled windows.
interpretation.next_physical_work: Eliminate per-cell quotient/remainder reconstruction from the ordinary runtime-shaped native transpose using coordinate/index induction, retaining the original output-row-major traversal, raw bit copies, full buffers, geometry/span/alias guards, factory/context/owner/fees/publication and callback boundaries. This differs from rejected transpose-consumer views and rejected rectangular comprehension traversal changes.

mvt_structural_division_count.limit: Derived from unchanged source/admitted shape and verified copy loop; not a measured hardware retired-instruction count.

interpretation.limits: No compiler speedup is inferred from these profiles. A materially changed fully qualified source must pass its one optimization probe and frozen formal gate; holdout remains independent.
